turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how's your day been so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to get into photography but my phone feels limiting.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: A dedicated camera opens up a lot. Are you thinking of a small compact camera, or a mirrorless one with lenses you can swap?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait a moment, my coworker is here. Please be quiet until I tell you I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Grace, which box did you put the kettle in?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: The one that says kitchen. Or maybe the one that says misc.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There are like six that say misc.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yeah, I got a bit lazy with the labels near the end.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you help me look? I really need a tea.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Start with the small ones. I'll check the ones by the door.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Welcome back! You were choosing between a compact camera and a mirrorless one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Mirrorless. I want to be able to grow into it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good choice. Start with the kit lens, and add a fifty millimeter prime later for portraits.
